title: AIRLOCK: controlled approvals, impact previews and durable execution
body:
AIRLOCK places a server-owned approval boundary around Agent tool calls. Bounded SQLite operations, registered HTTP/MCP CAS tools and fixed-repository GitHub Issue creation receive impact previews and an independent reviewer decision before execution. Execution rechecks identity, scope, request, policy, version, TTL and data state.

The implementation includes durable approval states, idempotency and concurrency handling, local atomic effect/state/audit commits, remote unknown-state reconciliation, separately approved compensation, scoped audit access, batch risk checks, budgets, an approval console and trace/cost/health instrumentation. Model advice, reversibility and budgets cannot authorize writes.

Startup now offers `python -m airlock doctor [--config ...] [--json]` for read-only configuration, in-memory SQLite and static console checks, with exit 0/2 and explicit unchecked areas. Malformed environment settings are redacted before Uvicorn starts; invalid installed console builds are rejected before Gate can initialize or recover a persistent database. Configuration reads are bounded and reject ambiguous JSON. Independent browser counterexamples also corrected CRLF/CR CSP hash interpretation. Environment precedence, existing configuration/data, and API-only startup remain covered.

Both [source CI 37167936489](https://github.com/Changxin-YR/AIRLOCK/actions/runs/37167936489) at `7dcea8ab94b60753391e0d90a73179684fc39fe1` and [delivery CI 37168715642](https://github.com/Changxin-YR/AIRLOCK/actions/runs/37168715642) at `7088ffbb9a5b38636240f226a885f1467b58f7b9` pass: 796 Python tests, 6 JavaScript tests, 31 native browser checks, official MCP SDK interop, frozen benchmarks/ablations, isolated Docker/network tests, S3 Object Lock, Envoy/OTel and dependency/evidence gates. The three real Linux symlink cases pass; local Windows limitations remain recorded separately. Both downloaded ZIPs match GitHub digests, all 94 payload hashes, embedded source commits and 24 clean-source subprocess receipts; the functional verifier exits 0. Application and executable acceptance code are unchanged between source and delivery.

The [startup evidence archive](https://github.com/Changxin-YR/AIRLOCK/tree/codex/full-audit-2026-10-02/evidence/startup-preflight-20261004) preserves 120 original local files, including failures, independent counterexamples and source snapshots, plus the complete source CI ZIP. All 228 public evidence payloads and 9 document bindings were read back from committed Git objects. Git has no automatic expiry and is not independent WORM custody. Source and delivery Actions copies expire on 2027-01-02; exact times, final-delivery logs and verification receipts are recorded on `memory/progress`.

The [126-target ledger](https://github.com/Changxin-YR/AIRLOCK/blob/codex/full-audit-2026-10-02/docs/acceptance/COMPLETION_MATRIX.json) retains all original criteria: 111 IMPLEMENTED / 15 PARTIAL, and 105 scoped PASS / 21 BLOCKED_EXTERNAL. Representative human/business validation and actual production identity, custody and notification environments remain open. No new paid-model calls or human-study records were produced. No known unresolved P0/P1 remains in the tested scope; local preflight does not certify production readiness or external integrations.

Project documentation centers on actual use cases, setup, integration and maintenance. See [README](https://github.com/Changxin-YR/AIRLOCK/blob/codex/full-audit-2026-10-02/README.md), [operations](https://github.com/Changxin-YR/AIRLOCK/blob/codex/full-audit-2026-10-02/docs/OPERATIONS.md), [report](https://github.com/Changxin-YR/AIRLOCK/blob/codex/full-audit-2026-10-02/docs/acceptance/FINAL_REPORT.md) and [findings](https://github.com/Changxin-YR/AIRLOCK/blob/codex/full-audit-2026-10-02/docs/acceptance/FINDINGS_AND_FIXES.md). This PR remains draft and unmerged; main is `704b5035cf69f9a6c40c44eecd84c0d0741de849`.
